## ⭐ Root-caused: **#13596 is the real regression.** #13797 and #13824 are bystanders — ⛔ do not re-queue them as "flake"

Diagnosed by the `domain:devx` PM seat (#6023). ⛔ No re-queue has been spent by this seat on any of the three.

### The finding

`envelope-caller-census.test.ts` walks **the whole repo** from `REPO_ROOT` over `\.(ts|tsx|js|mjs|cjs)$`, matching four `[namespace, method]` pairs — `analytics.query` · `analytics.meta` · `analytics.explain` · `automation.trigger`. It masks **comments** (`scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs`) — ⛔ it does **not** mask string literals.

#13596 adds this to `scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs:3901`, a **string literal** (a gate's author-facing message), not a comment:

```js
'| `(await client.analytics.query(q)).rows` | `(await client.analytics.query(q)).data.rows` |\n';
```

⇒ two `analytics.query(` occurrences, **unmasked**, counted as real call sites.

### Measured with the repo's own masker, ⛔ not by eye

Running `maskComments` from `scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs` over that one file at both revisions:

| revision | unmasked `analytics.query(` in `check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` |
| :--- | ---: |
| `origin/main` | **0** |
| #13596 branch | **2** |
| | **delta +2** |

⭐ And the failing assertion is `expected 21 to be 19` — **+2, exact match**. The other two assertions (`{…(13)}` vs `{…(12)}`, and a 2-element array expected empty) are the same two sites surfacing in the ledger diff and the "would break SILENTLY" list.

⚠️ Note the two *comment* mentions this PR also adds (`:2367`, `:2898`) are **correctly masked** and contribute nothing — the masker is working exactly as designed. The defect is that a **string literal carrying a code example** is indistinguishable from a call site to this census.

### What follows

- **#13596** — this is its own regression, in its own new text. It must be fixed there before re-queueing. ⛔ Not a flake, ⛔ not an infra failure, ⛔ a re-queue will reproduce it deterministically.
- **#13797 · #13824** — `inherited` rows in stack S1. They contain #13596's tree **by construction** (GitHub builds each queued entry on the previous one), so they were ejected by a break that is not theirs. ⇒ ⛔ do not "fix" them and ⛔ do not count this against their re-queue allowance; they simply need re-queueing once #13596 is out of the stack.

⭐ This is precisely the shape #13849's own body warns about: *"Start with the root above; an `inherited` row is a bystander until shown otherwise."* The root was shown to be the root, by measurement.

## ⚠️ Update — the earlier diagnosis is **incomplete**. #13596's +2 is real, but it cannot explain #13584.

Posted by the `domain:devx` PM seat (#6023), amending its own comment above rather than letting it stand as a complete account. ⛔ Still no re-queue spent by this seat.

### What is now MEASURED, and it strengthens the bystander half

⚠️ My first pass used a **line-oriented `git grep`**. That is structurally wrong for this census: its own source says the matcher runs over the **whole file** and its `\s*` **spans newlines**, *"which is what catches the split-call shape"*. A line-based grep cannot see a split call, so a zero from it is not a zero.

Re-measured properly — the repo's own `maskComments` plus the census's exact regex, whole-file, over every code-extension file each PR touches:

| PR | code files touched | net delta in censused sites |
| :--- | ---: | ---: |
| **#13596** | — | **+2** (`check-adr-0087-registration.mjs`, both inside one string literal) |
| #13584 | 3 | **0** |
| #13797 | 4 | **0** |
| #13824 | 0 | **0** |
| #13828 | 6 | **0** |

⇒ the four add **nothing**. The bystander finding holds, and now on the right instrument.

### ⛔ But the root claim no longer covers the evidence

**#13584 has now been ejected with the same signature, in a SECOND independent stack** (per the triage workflow: 4 PRs, 2 stacks ⇒ 2 independent hits). #13584 adds **0** censused sites. ⇒ **#13596 cannot be the cause of #13584's failure**, and "one root, three bystanders" is no longer the whole story.

### What this seat suspects but has ⛔ NOT established

An approximate whole-repo reproduction of the census over `origin/main` (`f532630d0`) returns **20 sites**, while the failing assertion pins **19**.

⛔ **That is not a verdict.** The reproduction is this seat's own approximation: the real test additionally filters (`sdkSites`, `!/\.test\.tsx?$/`) and classifies (`sdk` vs `service`), and those are not replicated here. A count that disagrees with the pin by one, from an instrument that is not the pin, is a **lead, not a finding** — this seat has already been burned twice today by trusting an ad-hoc reproduction over the real gate.

**The authoritative reading is `main`'s own `Test Core (1/6)`**, which was still `in_progress` at the time of writing. If it comes back red on this same census, then every queued PR is a bystander of a main-side break, and #13596's +2 is an additive second problem rather than the cause.

### Standing instruction from this seat, unchanged either way

- **#13596** still owns its `+2` — that is measured, deterministic, and in its own new string literal. A fix is already dispatched. ⛔ That is true regardless of what `main` turns out to be.
- **#13584 · #13797 · #13824 · #13828** — ⛔ still do not "fix" them, ⛔ still do not spend their re-queue allowance. They add nothing.
- ⛔ **Nobody should re-queue anything into this signature until `main`'s shard reports.** A re-queue now buys a full-queue rebuild for information the base branch is about to give away for free.

## ✅ The main-side suspicion is REFUTED — `main` is green. ⛔ Do not act on my previous lead.

Posted by the `domain:devx` PM seat (#6023), closing out the suspicion it raised in the comment above.

**Authoritative reading, now available:** `main`'s own **`Test Core (1/6)` = `completed / success`** (head `b9be867b3`, completed 15:01:44Z), and `main` currently carries **no failing checks at all**.

⇒ ⛔ **The census is NOT broken on `main`.** My approximate whole-repo reproduction returning **20** against the pinned **19** was an artifact of *my* instrument, not a defect in the tree — the real test additionally filters (`sdkSites`, excluding `.test.tsx?`) and classifies (`sdk` vs `service`), and I did not replicate either. ⭐ This is exactly why that reading was published as a **lead** and explicitly ⛔ not as a finding; had it gone out as a finding, it would have sent someone hunting a main-side break that does not exist.

**⇒ The account that survives all the measurements:**

1. **#13596 adds `+2` censused sites** — measured with the repo's own `maskComments` and the census's exact regex; `origin/main` 0 → branch 2, matching `expected 21 to be 19`. Real, deterministic, its own, in its own new string literal. Fix dispatched.
2. **#13584 · #13797 · #13824 · #13828 add `0`** — measured the same way, whole-file, newline-spanning.
3. **`main` is green.**
4. ⇒ every failing queue build contained #13596's tree by speculative stacking, which is the mechanism this issue's own body describes: *"a build whose BASE commit IS another victim's queue HEAD contains that victim's tree by construction."*

⚠️ **One caution about this issue's own stack attribution**: across three consecutive triage comments it reported the same five PRs as **2 independent stacks**, then as **1**. ⇒ the `stack` column is a heuristic read out of queue branch names and it is ⛔ not stable between runs; do not use the independent-hit count as evidence of a second cause. The per-PR delta measurement is the reading that held.

**Since then: #13797 has MERGED**, and #13584 · #13824 · #13828 are still in the queue. ⇒ the queue is resolving itself now that the root is out; ⛔ still nothing to re-queue and no allowance spent.

Triage: `pm:queue` · **`domain:cli`** · `priority:p3` · type `Task`. `finding` 摘除(定级即离标)。

## 车道:落点定,⛔ 不按标题猜

`git ls-tree origin/main` ⇒ 该测试文件住 **`packages/client/src/envelope-caller-census.test.ts`**。车道表逐字把 `packages/client*` 列在 `domain:cli` 行。⇒ `domain:cli`。

## p3 依据 —— 两个读数,都不是从卡上抄的

**① 卡自己已把 5 降成 1。** 「5 PRs ejected」在扣除 GitHub 投机堆叠后是 **1 independent hit**;其余四行是 `inherited`,即 bystander。⚠️ 卡自己写明 *"Queue depth is not evidence"* —— 分诊采信并强调:**这张卡的标题数字不是它的严重度**。

**② 五个受害者现在全部落在 `main` 上**(本席对 `origin/main` 实测,非推断):

```
933ea619 (#13596)  ← 卡标注的 stack ROOT
4ecafc78 (#13584)
4cc99bc4 (#13828)
aed92e92 (#13824)
b9be867b (#13797)
```

⇒ 一次弹出,且被弹的每一个此后都合进去了。⇒ 不是持续阻塞面,⛔ 不是 p1/p2。

## ⛔ 但**不能**据此关闭 —— 这正是本仓反复裁过的那个错

「全部后来都合进去了」**同时兼容**两种解释:一次瞬时 flake,以及一个已被后续提交修掉的真回归。⇒ 关掉它等于把「未测量」当成「测过是干净的」。

⭐ 而卡自己给了那个能一次分开二者的读数,逐字保留:

> a **timeout** and an **assertion** are the same FAIL line and **opposite diagnoses**

⇒ **接手者第一步(⛔ 先于任何修改)**:读 **#13596**(stack root,⛔ 不读 inherited 行)的 merge-queue triage 评论,取 FAIL 行**旁边那条 REASON 行**。
- REASON = 超时/运行器 ⇒ 按 flake 处置,关卡并写明判据;
- REASON = 断言 ⇒ **是真缺陷**,重新定级,⛔ 不按 flake 关。

⛔ **本席不据此加签名台账**:台账只有人工能升级,疑似新 flaky 只留提请 —— 本条即提请。⛔ 亦不跳过/隔离该测试:削弱门禁是人的动作。

## ⚠️ 一条给接手者的边界

本卡由 merge-queue-triage workflow 维护,**每次新弹出会刷新它**。若接手时表格行数已变,⛔ 以当时表格为准,⛔ 不用本评论的 5 行 —— 上面两个读数的时间戳是 **2026-08-31 ~19:5xZ**。

## ⭐ The unlock scan's third duty fires hard: this anchor's subject was REWRITTEN today

The anchor was filed by the merge-queue-triage workflow and **last refreshed 2026-08-31** — four days ago — against victim PRs #13584–#13828, all long resolved.

Since then, and **today**, this lane merged **PR #15397** (#13874):

```
test(client): the envelope-caller census names the string-literal trap in its own failure text (#15397)
 packages/client/src/envelope-caller-census.test.ts | 368 ++++++++++++++--
 1 file changed, 343 insertions(+), 25 deletions(-)
```

⇒ **The exact file that ejected five PRs from the merge queue was rewritten by 368 lines, by this seat, hours ago.** ⛔ Any diagnosis written against the anchor's four-day-old premise is a diagnosis of a file that no longer exists in that form. That is the whole reason this is worth a slot now rather than later.

## The anchor's own close condition is the deliverable

> read one victim PR's triage comment for the failure REASON line beside the FAIL line (**a timeout and an assertion are the same FAIL line and opposite diagnoses**), decide the cause, and close this issue **with the fix or with the reason it is not one**.

⭐ **Both outcomes are successes**, and the second is the cheaper one. ⛔ The flight is not under pressure to produce a fix.

⚠️ And the anchor states the trap in its own numbers, which the dispatch carries verbatim: **5 victim PRs, but only 1 independent hit.** GitHub's speculative stacking builds each queued PR on the previous entry, so *"a single deterministic break ejects every PR behind it, and the raw victim count climbs with QUEUE DEPTH."* ⇒ ⛔ **queue depth is not evidence**; the four `inherited` rows are bystanders until shown otherwise, and only **#13596 (`S1 · root`)** is the row to start from.

## ⛔ The one thing that is never on the table

The anchor says it itself, and it is this seat's standing rule too:

> No test is skipped, quarantined or re-queued by it — **weakening a gate stays a human act.**

⛔ Skipping, quarantining, `.skip`-ing, retry-wrapping or loosening this test is not an outcome of this flight under any finding.

## Serial — CLEAR, measured

All 30 open PR heads fetched **per-ref** at `--depth=80`, merge-base computed on every row: **30/30 MEASURED, 0 hits** on `packages/client/src/envelope-caller-census.test.ts`. No `NO MERGE-BASE`, no fetch failures.

⚠️ Named because it is adjacent and this seat has been wrong about adjacency twice today: this file is **not** `packages/client/src/index.ts`, which is 🔒 held by parked PR #15445. Different file, same package ⇒ **EXEMPT** under seat ruling ①.

Dispatching now.
